Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time this morning to walk through FintechCorp's security and compliance requirements. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of what we covered:
- SOC 2 status: you mentioned SOC 2 Type II is required for procurement; question on whether a redacted report + bridge letter will be acceptable during contract review.
- Data residency & GDPR: primary concern is EU data processing for EEA customers; you asked about our data export controls and contractual DPAs.
- Incident response & breach notification: you asked for our standard notification SLA and examples of incident response evidence (forensics summary, timelines).
- BCP / DR: FintechCorp is requesting a short summary of our failover plan and RTO/RPO targets for Dedicated deployments.
- Vendor security questionnaire: you indicated procurement will send the questionnaire; we can also push an initial vendor security packet if that helps speed review.

Proposed next steps (action owners):
1) Jordan (me): share SOC 2 redacted report + short SOC summary and our standard breach notification timelines (attached). Target: today EOD.
2) Jordan & Jasmine: initiate the Redwood vendor security questionnaire form for FintechCorp and pre-fill details we discussed. Target: by EOD 3/28.
3) Marissa (Legal): review whether a SOC 2 bridge letter or attestation is available for contract-stage review and confirm what redactions are acceptable. Target: 3/29.
4) FintechCorp (Alex/Priya): share any procurement-specific questionnaire or required evidence matrix; indicate desired turnaround for initial review.

Attachments I will share: SOC2 redacted report, Redwood BCP/DR summary, and the initial vendor questionnaire (stub). If procurement prefers a DocuSign/Share link instead, let us know.

Open question from the call: when does FintechCorp require formal breach notification (e.g., within 72 hours after confirming personal data exposure)? Please confirm the required timeline so we can map to our legal/ops processes.

Happy to hop on a short follow-up if helpful — Jasmine and I are available Mon/Tue next week for an RFC call to walk procurement through the packet.

Best,

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear recap and quick turnaround. A few clarifications from procurement/security: 

1) SOC 2: A redacted Type II report is fine to start procurement, but our security team typically requests a recent test period (within last 12 months) and a short attestation/bridge letter that nothing material changed since the report date. If you can provide the SOC 2 pdf + a short note on the period covered, that will expedite review.

2) Breach notification timeline: For FintechCorp we require notification of confirmed personal data breaches within 72 hours of confirmation (per GDPR expectations) and immediate escalation to our security leadership for incidents impacting production environments. We'll need a mapping of your detection -> confirmation -> notification steps and typical SLAs. 

3) BCP/DR: Our platform team will want RTO/RPO numbers for production Dedicated deployments and a brief runbook for failover. The summary you mentioned should suffice for initial screening.

4) Vendor security questionnaire: We'll attach our standard vendor questionnaire to this thread (procurement will send the doc in a separate email). If you can pre-fill any fields, that will help.

Preferred turnaround for initial packet review: 5 business days after we receive your SOC 2 + BCP summary.

Appreciate you and team moving quickly on this.

Regards,
Alex Turner
Head of Procurement\FintechCorp

Alex / Priya —

Thanks — attaching the redacted SOC 2 Type II report and our BCP/DR summary (see attachments). A few specifics below to address your asks: 

SOC 2: Attached file SOC2_TypeII_Report_redacted.pdf covers period 2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31. We can provide a short attestation/bridge letter from our E&C team confirming no material changes since the report date; Marissa is looping in to confirm delivery timeline (Marissa: can Legal produce this by Monday 3/30?).

Breach notification / IR timelines (high level):
- Detection: automated alerts + on-call SRE triage (target detection: within minutes for critical alerts)
- Confirmation: security engineering + incident commander analysis (target confirmation: 24 hours)
- Notification: customers + regulators as required (target notification: within 72 hours of confirmation for incidents involving personal data)
- For P1 incidents affecting production, we issue an initial notification within 2 hours of confirming impact to customers (followed by timeline updates).

We can provide sample redacted incident summaries on request — those contain the timeline, root cause, mitigations, and post-incident actions (we'll redact customer-identifying info).

BCP/DR summary: attached Redwood_BCP_DR_Summary.pdf includes RTO/RPO targets for Dedicated: RTO = 2 hours (regional failover), RPO = 15 minutes (KV-based replication + checkpointing). Full runbook is available under NDA; initial summary should be sufficient for procurement screening.

Vendor questionnaire: I have pre-filled a portion of the questionnaire and uploaded it as Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Initial.xlsx. I will also kick off a secure vendor-form link so your procurement team can fill remaining items and submit supporting evidence. Link: https://vendor-questionnaire.redwood.com/form/fintechcorp-FT-2026-042

Related docs & links: https://redwood-docs.internal/security/soc2-summary (SOC Q&A) and shared Drive folder for additional evidence: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/FT-2026-042/BCP_summary

Open items / asks for FintechCorp: 
- Please confirm procurement's desired turnaround (you suggested 5 business days) and attach the vendor questionnaire when available.
- Confirm whether an interim attestation/bridge letter is acceptable in lieu of an unredacted SOC 2 until contract signature.

Marissa / Laura / Jasmine: can you confirm availability to join a 30-minute call next week to walk procurement/security through the packet and answer any detailed IR/BCP questions? Suggested slots: Mon 3/30 10:00-11:00 PT or Tue 3/31 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks — Jordan
